description: Workers, placement, actors, snapshots and their store, sandbox resources, caches, routing and calls of the Agent Substrate that runs the sandboxes of Aviary, from the metrics that its components serve.

panels.title: Components up
panels.description: Pods of Substrate's components that the last scrape reached, of those that it found: the API servers, atelet on each node, the router, the egress gateway and the controller.

panels.title: Workers
panels.description: Workers of the pools that are ready, and the number that their WorkerPools ask for. Fewer ready than desired for minutes means that the capacity did not arrive: no node, a quota, or a worker pod that cannot start.

panels.title: Resume p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time that the API server took to wake an actor in the selected range, from the request to a running actor.

panels.title: No room
panels.description: Attempts in the selected range to place an actor that found no worker with room for it. A turn waits for room, and fails if none comes in time.

panels.title: Crashes
panels.description: Actors that crashed in the selected range. A crashed sandbox is reverted to its last snapshot, and the turn that it ran fails.

panels.title: Oldest snapshot not stored
panels.description: Age of the oldest snapshot on a node that is not in the store yet. A healthy node stays below the upload delay plus one upload: until then, a sandbox whose node goes away loses its state since its last stored snapshot.

panels.title: Workers by state
panels.description: Workers of the pools by how full they are: idle, partial, at capacity, or unschedulable. Every API server reports the whole fleet, so the replicas are averaged before the sum.

targets.expr: sum by (ate_worker_state) (avg by (ate_workerpool_namespace, ate_workerpool_name, ate_worker_state, ate_sandbox_class) (ate_workerpool_workers{namespace="$namespace", ate_workerpool_name=~"$pool"}))

panels.title: Desired and ready workers
panels.description: The workers that each WorkerPool asks for, and those that are ready.

panels.title: Placements per minute
panels.description: Attempts of the scheduler to place an actor on a worker, by outcome: assigned, no capacity, or error.

panels.title: Placement time
panels.description: Time of one attempt of the scheduler to place an actor, by percentile.

panels.title: Placement errors per minute
panels.description: Attempts to place an actor that failed, by error.

panels.title: Operations per minute
panels.description: Operations of the API server on actors: create, resume, suspend, delete and the others.

panels.title: Failed operations per minute
panels.description: Operations on actors that failed, by operation and error. ResourceExhausted on resume means that no worker had room.

panels.title: Crashes per minute
panels.description: Actors that crashed, by template.

panels.title: Operation time p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time of each operation on actors.

panels.title: Resume time p95 by snapshot
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time to wake an actor, by the snapshot that it woke from: boot for a new actor, latest for its last snapshot.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, ate_snapshot_kind, ate_snapshot_fidelity) (rate(ate_actor_lifecycle_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="$namespace", ate_workerpool_name=~"$pool", ate_template_name=~"$template", ate_actor_operation_name="resume"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Restore time p95 by phase
panels.description: 95th percentile of each phase of a restore on a node: fetching the manifest, downloading the snapshot, unpacking the image, mounting volumes, and restoring the worker.

panels.title: Checkpoint time p95 by phase
panels.description: 95th percentile of each phase of taking a snapshot on a node.

panels.title: Restores and checkpoints per minute
panels.description: Restores and checkpoints on the nodes, by the kind of snapshot.

panels.title: Snapshot size p95 by file
panels.description: 95th percentile of the size of each file of a snapshot, such as the memory pages and the archives of the file systems.

panels.title: Snapshot size p95 by template
panels.description: 95th percentile of the size of the files of the snapshots of each template.

panels.title: Uploads and detaches per minute
panels.description: Snapshots that the nodes uploaded to the store, and sandboxes whose snapshots left their nodes, with those that failed.

panels.title: Upload and detach time p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time of an upload to the store, and of a detach, which deletes the files of a snapshot from its node.

panels.title: Overdue p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of how long after it came due an upload or a detach started: near zero while the node keeps up.

panels.title: Actors waiting for an upload
panels.description: Actors on the nodes whose snapshot is past its upload delay and not in the store yet, by how overdue.

panels.title: Oldest snapshot not stored, by node
panels.description: Age of the oldest snapshot of each node that is not in the store yet.

panels.title: CPU by template
panels.description: CPU that the awake sandboxes of each template use, as atelet samples them.

panels.title: Memory by template
panels.description: Memory that the awake sandboxes of each template use, and their working set.

panels.title: Sampled sandboxes
panels.description: Awake sandboxes of each template that the last sample measured.

panels.title: Image cache per minute
panels.description: Lookups of images in the cache of the nodes, by outcome. A miss pulls and unpacks the image, which a wake on that node waits for.

panels.title: File cache size
panels.description: Disk that the file caches of the nodes take, by cache: the snapshots and the assets of the sandboxes.

panels.title: File cache evictions per minute
panels.description: Entries that the file caches evicted. A steady rate at the budget means that the cache thrashes.

panels.title: File cache cleanups per minute
panels.description: Eviction passes over the file caches that had work to do, by outcome.

panels.title: Routed requests per minute
panels.description: Requests that the router, to the runners of the sandboxes, and the egress gateway, out of them, routed, by outcome.

panels.title: Routing time p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time to route a request, by component and by whether it woke its sandbox.

panels.title: Parked requests
panels.description: Requests that the router holds while their sandbox wakes, those that it refused, and the time that they waited.

panels.title: Calls served per second
panels.description: gRPC calls that each component served.

panels.title: Calls served that failed
panels.description: gRPC calls that the components served with a status other than OK, by method and status, per second.

panels.title: Time to serve p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time of the gRPC calls that the components served, by method.

panels.title: Calls made per second
panels.description: gRPC calls that each component made.

panels.title: Calls made that failed
panels.description: gRPC calls that the components made that ended with a status other than OK, by method and status, per second.

panels.title: Time of calls made p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time of the gRPC calls that the components made, by method.

panels.title: CPU by pod
panels.description: CPU that the processes of the components use.

panels.title: Memory by pod
panels.description: Resident memory of the processes of the components.

panels.title: Goroutines by pod
panels.description: Goroutines of the processes of the components.

title: Agent Substrate
